outcome: Damage dealt by a lifelink source makes its controller gain that much life in addition to the damage's other results.
A lifelink source that has left its zone before dealing damage is checked for lifelink by last known information, so its controller still gains life.
A lifelink source deals damage and causes life gain from any zone, such as a lifelink creature card dealing damage from the graveyard or exile.
Several lifelink sources dealing damage simultaneously cause separate life gain events, so each triggers life-gain abilities separately.
